name: SC Veltheim
note: Not a German club and not a 3. Liga club. The only reason it reaches this map is a league tag on its Wikidata item pointing at Q154069, the German 3. Liga. The club is the Swiss SC Veltheim from the Veltheim district of Winterthur, registered with the Fussballverband Region Zuerich as club 1556 and playing in the Swiss 2. Liga, so that tag is a wrong link - most likely the Swiss 3. Liga was meant. Established 2026-09-18 from two web searches agreeing on the club, its town and its league; the fvrz.ch and Wikipedia pages themselves could not be opened from the machine that checked this, so re-read them before relying on the Swiss league named here. The skip itself does not depend on it: whichever Swiss league is meant, the club does not belong on a German tier-3 map.

name: TSV 1860 München II
note: Bayernliga Sud, tier 5. Wikidata still tags it Regionalliga Bayern (Q340179), which is why it arrives at tier 4. TIER ONLY - the venue, capacity and coordinates cells are deliberately left blank because the ground is genuinely unconfirmed, not merely unchecked. BUT LEAVING THEM BLANK DOES NOT CLEAR THEM: a blank cell means 'leave the fetched value alone', so this club keeps Wikidata's claim of the Grunwalder (P115 Q254903), its coordinates 48.110833/11.574444 and its 15000 capacity, all of which are the senior club's and none of which is verified. That is the same kind of copied-ground error as CS Dinamo above. Until the real ground is settled this club still shares the Grunwalder pin with TSV 1860 Munchen and FC Bayern Munchen II - at z12 and above, since tier 5 does not switch on before then.

name: FC Triesenberg
